item.title: Bondi testimony proves she’s out of her depth as AG (Letters)
item.description: "Attorney General Pam Bondi does middle-school mean girl really well. The insults she hurls at members of Congress -- the people's representatives -- are choice and juvenile. " -- Floy Jeffares, Lakewood

item.title: Colorado’s second-half defense leads to victory against Oklahoma State
item.description: Colorado has been less than its best several times in the past few weeks. In most of those cases, the Buffaloes were trounced accordingly.

item.title: In Colorado state wrestling tournament heavyweight clash, Resurrection Christian star caps perfect season
item.description: Two years ago, Samuel Stockton sat in the underbelly of Ball Arena and cried after a state championship slipped through his fingertips.

item.title: Keeler: Why Pomona’s Colorado state wrestling dynasty is ‘not going anywhere’
item.description: The Pomona Panthers are Colorado's gold standard, our barometer and benchmark. Dissecting a beauty is one thing. But how do you dethrone a beast?

item.title: Broomfield’s Shayla Martinez remains perfect as she repeats as state wrestling champ
item.description: At the state tournament, she pinned everyone, sticking Loveland's Abigail Stearns in the exact same time as she did in last year's final — 63 seconds.

item.title: Colorado Buffs women’s basketball rallies past No. 20 Texas Tech
item.description: With the game on the line, the Colorado women’s basketball team cranked up its defense.

item.title: Keeler: Brighton’s Matilda Hruby tops Pomona’s Timberly Martinez in Colorado state wrestling tournament’s marquee match
item.description: Matilda Hruby, 29-0, waltzed. And grinned. And dabbed. And dominated. Colorado state wrestling championship ends with Hruby beating Timberly Martinez for third time this season.

item.title: For Colorado state champion wrestlers, having dad as coach makes the feat even more golden
item.description: When Joe Anderson got married, he also signed up to be a wrestling coach.

item.title: PHOTOS: 2026 Colorado high school state wrestling championships at Ball Arena.
item.description: Three days of Colorado high school state wrestling championships at Ball Arena, Feb. 2026. Hundreds of wrestlers from across Colorado swarmed the mats and battled for the state title in front of packed crowds at Ball Arena.
